note: Prompts were written by Kyra Hall. 'tests' were asked against the working copy freshly reset from data/campus_customs.db (before any ticket was worked). 'tests_after_full_run' were asked against the shipped data/campus_customs_new.db after tickets 101-103 were resolved. Every output matches its database state.

tests.prompt: The SOM Club Hockey Team wants to make a bulk order of Navy hoodies. Do we have sufficient stock (20 larges and 20 mediums) to fulfill their order?
tests.answer: No. Large has 14 (6 short of 20) and Medium has 8 (12 short of 20): 22 of the 40 hoodies are in stock, 18 short.

db_check.query: SELECT size, qty FROM inventory WHERE sku='CC-HOOD-NAVY' AND size IN ('L','M')

tests.prompt: Are there any invoices that have not been paid to any of our vendors?
tests.answer: Yes, one: invoice 501 to Bulldog Print Co (vendor 1), $840, due 2026-08-28, overdue as of 2026-08-31, so Bulldog will not ship (this blocks the size S tee restock for ticket 101). Elm City Gifts and QuickShip CT have none.

db_check.query: SELECT id, vendor_id, amount, due_date, status FROM invoices WHERE status='open'

tests.prompt: How much rent is due on lease 1 and when is it due?
tests.answer: $2,400 for the Chapel Street shop (Elm City Properties), due 2026-09-02, 2 days after the shop date.

db_check.query: SELECT monthly_rent, next_due FROM leases WHERE id=1; SELECT date_today FROM desk

tests_after_full_run.prompt: How many size medium navy hoodies do we have in stock now that all three tickets have been resolved?
tests_after_full_run.answer: 8, unchanged, because the team filed no restock PO for ticket 103 ($264 was more than the $152 left in checking).

db_check.query: SELECT qty FROM inventory WHERE sku='CC-HOOD-NAVY' AND size='M'

tests_after_full_run.prompt: Does Bulldog Print Co (Vendor 1) have any open invoices at this point?
tests_after_full_run.answer: No. Invoice 501 was paid (payment #1, $840, human-approved), so Bulldog can ship again.

db_check.query: SELECT id, status FROM invoices WHERE vendor_id=1

tests_after_full_run.prompt: When is rent next due on lease 1 now that we have paid September?
tests_after_full_run.answer: 2026-10-02 ($2,400), 32 days after the shop date; approving September's rent (payment #3) moved next_due forward one month.

db_check.query: SELECT monthly_rent, next_due FROM leases WHERE id=1
